release_notes: Cloud transcription + Prompting. Cloud transcription (opt-in) via OpenRouter — GPT-4o Transcribe, Whisper Large V3, Qwen3 ASR and more for higher accuracy when you want it; local Whisper stays the private, offline default. New Prompting mode: hover the recording pill and tap the sparkle to turn a dictation into a clean, structured prompt for a coding AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), with a research-backed prompt builder and a user-selectable, fast-by-default model. Your API key is stored in the macOS Keychain, never on disk. Fixes: a crash when reopening Settings, and the repeated Keychain password prompt when using your key.
